image_description: A man with long gray hair and a beard stands in a boat, holding a very large sturgeon horizontally. The fish spans the width of the frame. The background shows water and green reeds/trees on the shore. The lighting is natural daylight.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Elongated head with protrusible mouth on ventral surface.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The head is clearly elongated and tapered. While the exact ventral position of the mouth is hard to see from this side angle, the snout shape is consistent with a sturgeon.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Four barbels (sensory whiskers) anterior to mouth.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The resolution is insufficient to resolve the small barbels under the snout; they are not visible at this distance.
The snout tapers to a distinct point, matching the diagnostic criteria.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Elongated fusiform body with impressively large, extended proportions.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The fish has a classic torpedo/fusiform shape and appears very large relative to the human holder.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Five rows of bony scutes (plates) along body instead of scales.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Distinct rows of raised, bony plates (scutes) are visible running longitudinally along the lateral line and dorsal area. No typical fish scales are visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Gray, brown, or black dorsally with lighter ventral surface.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The top of the fish is dark gray/brown, fading to a lighter gray/white on the belly, consistent with sturgeon coloration.
The caudal fin is clearly visible on the right; the upper lobe is significantly larger and longer than the lower lobe, confirming the heterocercal structure.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific species identification and rule out look-alikes like paddlefish or gar.
To verify the continuity of the scutes and ensure the fins merge correctly with the body without melting artifacts.
To check for general AI generation artifacts like texture smearing or inconsistent lighting between the subject and background.
To detect the human subject and ensure anatomical correctness of the hands holding the fish, a common failure point in AI images.
